other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in training set target encoding
other_failure_modes.description: When applying target encoding to the training set, the agent computes the mean of the target on the entire training fold and maps it directly back to the same training fold. Without out-of-fold encoding (e.g., leave-one-out) or smoothing, the target value of each row leaks into its own features, leading to severe model overfitting.

summary: The agent implements a thorough feature engineering pipeline for this time-series forecasting task but makes two critical errors that invalidate the cross-validation score. First, it uses a randomly shuffled K-Fold split instead of a time-based split, causing severe look-ahead bias. Second, it computes target encodings on the training fold and directly maps them back without leave-one-out smoothing, causing the target to leak into the training features.
